name: ospf
description: Dynamic routing with FRR OSPF: adjacencies, ECMP from equal costs, and convergence after a silent failure vs a link-down

nodes.name: r1
setup:
touch /etc/frr/r1/vtysh.conf && printf 'interface eth1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
interface eth2
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.0.0.1
 network 198.18.20.0/22 area 0
 network 198.18.24.0/22 area 0
 passive-interface eth0
' > /etc/frr/r1/ospfd.conf && chown frr:frr /etc/frr/r1/ospfd.conf

nodes.name: r2
setup:
touch /etc/frr/r2/vtysh.conf && printf 'interface eth0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
interface eth1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.0.0.2
 network 198.18.20.0/22 area 0
 network 198.18.24.0/22 area 0
' > /etc/frr/r2/ospfd.conf && chown frr:frr /etc/frr/r2/ospfd.conf

nodes.name: r3
setup:
touch /etc/frr/r3/vtysh.conf && printf 'interface eth0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
interface eth1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.0.0.3
 network 198.18.20.0/22 area 0
 network 198.18.24.0/22 area 0
' > /etc/frr/r3/ospfd.conf && chown frr:frr /etc/frr/r3/ospfd.conf

nodes.name: r4
setup:
touch /etc/frr/r4/vtysh.conf && printf 'interface eth0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
interface eth1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.0.0.4
 network 198.18.20.0/22 area 0
 network 198.18.24.0/22 area 0
 passive-interface eth2
' > /etc/frr/r4/ospfd.conf && chown frr:frr /etc/frr/r4/ospfd.conf

checks.name: OSPF adjacencies come up on both router links (hello 1 s, dead 4 s, point-to-point)
run: vtysh -N r1 -c 'show ip ospf neighbor'; echo "full adjacencies: $(vtysh -N r1 -c 'show ip ospf neighbor' | grep -c Full)"

checks.name: r1 learned hb's network from OSPF, with two equal-cost next hops
run: vtysh -N r1 -c 'show ip route 198.18.26.0/24'; ip route show 198.18.26.0/24

checks.name: the OSPF view: the route, its cost, and its two next hops
ha reaches hb across three routers (TTL 61)
which path does this flow use? (hash policy 0: addresses only, so one path for all ha-to-hb traffic)
run: nh=$(ip netns exec nl-ospf-r1 ip route get 198.18.26.10 from 198.18.21.10 iif eth0 | grep -o 'via [0-9.]*' | cut -d' ' -f2); if [ $nh = 198.18.22.2 ]; then r=r2; else r=r3; fi; echo "r1 forwards ha->hb via $nh ($r)"; echo $r > /tmp/netlab-ospf-victim

checks.name: silent failure: that router keeps its links up but stops forwarding and stops OSPF; neighbours notice only when hellos stop (dead interval 4 s)
run: ping -i 0.05 -c 200 -W 1 -q 198.18.26.10 > /tmp/netlab-ospf-ping.txt & sleep 1; r=$(cat /tmp/netlab-ospf-victim); ip netns exec nl-ospf-$r iptables -I FORWARD -j DROP; ip netns exec nl-ospf-$r iptables -I INPUT -p ospf -j DROP; ip netns exec nl-ospf-$r iptables -I OUTPUT -p ospf -j DROP; wait; cat /tmp/netlab-ospf-ping.txt; awk '/transmitted/ {lost=$1-$4; printf "lost %d of %d probes = about %.2f s without connectivity\n", lost, $1, lost*0.05}' /tmp/netlab-ospf-ping.txt

checks.name: after the dead interval r1 has one next hop left
heal it
run: r=$(cat /tmp/netlab-ospf-victim); ip netns exec nl-ospf-$r iptables -F; echo healed $r

checks.name: adjacencies and ECMP return
run: echo "full adjacencies: $(vtysh -N r1 -c 'show ip ospf neighbor' | grep -c Full)"; ip route show 198.18.26.0/24

checks.name: which path now?
run: nh=$(ip netns exec nl-ospf-r1 ip route get 198.18.26.10 from 198.18.21.10 iif eth0 | grep -o 'via [0-9.]*' | cut -d' ' -f2); if [ $nh = 198.18.22.2 ]; then r=r2; else r=r3; fi; echo "r1 forwards ha->hb via $nh ($r)"; echo $r > /tmp/netlab-ospf-victim

checks.name: loud failure: that router's link to r1 goes DOWN; r1 sees the carrier loss and reroutes at once
run: ping -i 0.05 -c 100 -W 1 -q 198.18.26.10 > /tmp/netlab-ospf-ping.txt & sleep 1; r=$(cat /tmp/netlab-ospf-victim); ip netns exec nl-ospf-$r ip link set eth0 down; wait; cat /tmp/netlab-ospf-ping.txt; awk '/transmitted/ {lost=$1-$4; printf "lost %d of %d probes = about %.2f s without connectivity\n", lost, $1, lost*0.05}' /tmp/netlab-ospf-ping.txt
